state_and_ABI_limits.mode: Physical decoding is x86-32 only; current execution mode, segment descriptors, mappings, permissions, register values and memory values remain unestablished. Decoder group not64bitmode is not a live-mode proof.
state_and_ABI_limits.stack: Renew current SS.B=1 independently at every PUSH, CALL, POP, LEAVE and RET. Under that predicate and normal successful completion, PUSH and near CALL decrement current ESP by four and write four bytes through current SS; CALL writes its encoded return offset. Each POP and near RET reads through current SS at its own current ESP, then increments ESP by four. No aggregate stack delta, balance, caller identity, argument or callee-saved contract is inferred.
state_and_ABI_limits.leave: For C9 in the saved 32-bit operand interpretation and renewed current SS.B=1, take B as current EBP: ESP becomes B, EBP receives the four-byte value through current SS at offset B, and ESP becomes (B+4) modulo 2^32 on normal completion. No equality to an earlier EBP/ESP or frame reconstruction is inferred after opaque calls.
state_and_ABI_limits.memory: EBP-4 and EBP-8 operands default to current SS; EAX+3C, ESI+6, ESI+14 and absolute CE215C default to current DS. Offsets are recomputed from current registers. No flat-segment equality or non-alias relation is established. Stack writes may alias later explicit memory operands.
state_and_ABI_limits.lea: LEA EAX,[EBP-4] and LEA EDI,[EAX+ESI+18] compute 32-bit effective offsets only, without reading a memory value or applying a segment base. Their ModR/M memory-shaped operands do not establish mapped data structures.
state_and_ABI_limits.widths: 66 at C04F2E makes CMP a 16-bit word/BX operation while address size remains 32. Both 0F B7 forms read a word and zero-extend it into EAX. SIB 30 at C04F36 encodes scale one, index ESI and base EAX. Encoded imm8 values in 83 forms are sign-extended to the 32-bit operation.
state_and_ABI_limits.flags: XOR/AND/TEST set SF/ZF/PF from the logical result, reset CF/OF and leave AF undefined on normal completion; TEST stores no result. ADD/CMP update arithmetic flags, with CMP storing no result. INC updates OF/SF/ZF/AF/PF and leaves CF unchanged. JLE tests ZF or SF unequal OF; JBE tests CF or ZF; JE tests ZF; JB tests CF. MOV, MOVZX, LEA, PUSH and POP do not overwrite the intervening comparison flags.
state_and_ABI_limits.local_composition: Conditional on uninterrupted normal execution, self-XOR clears ESI or EBX; the intervening LEA permits the following INC ESI to produce one. CMP C04F16 reaches JLE C04F1B through POP; CMP C04F2E reaches JBE C04F3A through MOVZX/LEA; TEST C04F47 reaches JE C04F4B through two POPs; CMP C04F55 directly supplies JB C04F57. No flags or register values are propagated across an opaque call.
state_and_ABI_limits.and_zero: AND dword [EBP-8],0 is still a memory read-modify-write, including a read before the zero result is stored. Its zero result does not bypass access checks, prove writable memory or establish a return-value meaning.
state_and_ABI_limits.calls: Direct targets BFBB61 and C05920 and the computed call through current DS offset CE215C remain opaque and unqueried. The computed call reads its four-byte target operand in the pre-instruction state before its own stack write. If any call returns, all returned registers, flags, memory and segment state are treated as unknown; saved library labels do not establish preservation.
state_and_ABI_limits.literals: D69FB8 is an encoded immediate, with its referent unread. CE215C is a numeric data offset only. The observed offset pattern does not authenticate an import, provider, string, executable-header layout, library identity or function prototype.
state_and_ABI_limits.control: Relative target arithmetic is numeric code-offset evidence only. RET C3 has no encoded immediate stack adjustment, no ordinary fallthrough, and an unknown current stack target. No reachability, successful call return or whole-function behavior is inferred.
state_and_ABI_limits.boundary: C04F67, all direct callee bodies, computed targets, data-cell contents, immediate referents, prototypes and providers remain unqueried.
